# Ascalon

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-24

## Definition
Ascalon is Tenstorrent's RISC-V CPU series designed for AI and general-purpose computing within open chiplet ecosystems. As a RISC-V core in a chiplet architecture, Ascalon can serve as a node type in TCC and iNEST topologies for heterogeneous compute.
